e.title: insurance-gas
e.summary: GAS 动态定价（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：广义自回归得分模型，时变参数
e.summary_en: GAS dynamic pricing (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): generalised autoregressive score models, time-varying parameters
e.summary_hk: GAS 動態定價（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：廣義自迴歸得分模型，時變參數
e.body: insurance-gas（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）实现 GAS（Generalised Autoregressive Score）模型：模型参数随得分（似然梯度）自适应演化——动态定价的时变参数方法。对 RIAA：GAS 是动态定价的现代框架（[[insurance-dynamics]] 综合包的核心组件）——比随机游走更有效（利用似然信息）；与 [[insurance-trend]]（趋势）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（变点）配套构成时间维度工具箱；适合车险/家财险的费率时效性建模；score-driven 模型在金融计量与精算之间架桥。
e.body_en: insurance-gas (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) implements GAS ([[generali|Generali]]sed Autoregressive Score) models: model parameters adapt via scores (likelihood gradients) — time-varying parameters for dynamic pricing. For RIAA: GAS is the modern framework for dynamic pricing (core component of the [[insurance-dynamics]] suite) — more efficient than random walks (uses likelihood information); with [[insurance-trend]] (trend) and [[insurance-changepoint]] (change points) it forms the time-dimension toolbox; suits rate-timeliness modelling in motor/home; score-driven models bridge financial econometrics and actuarial science.
e.body_hk: insurance-gas（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）實現 GAS（Generalised Autoregressive Score）模型：模型參數隨得分（似然梯度）自適應演化——動態定價的時變參數方法。對 RIAA：GAS 是動態定價的現代框架（[[insurance-dynamics]] 綜合包的核心組件）——比隨機游走更有效（利用似然信息）；與 [[insurance-trend]]（趨勢）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（變點）配套構成時間維度工具箱；適合車險/家財險的費率時效性建模；score-driven 模型在金融計量與精算之間架橋。
